app.name: Mothakira
app.errorHint: The server did not answer. This is not an empty list — try again.
app.forbiddenBody: Your account does not have access to this area. Ask the owner if you need it.
app.notFoundBody: That record does not exist, or it was removed.
app.offlineBody: Your session is still saved. Reconnect and try again.
app.blockedNotice: This account is blocked. Contact the owner.
app.sessionExpiredNotice: Your session ended. Sign in again.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Admin access to Mothakira
login.hint: Owner, payment reviewer and content editor accounts only.
login.headline: Every paper, every transfer, one desk.
login.lede: Review Bankak transfers, publish exam papers and keep the credit ledger honest.
login.fact1Body: Approval is checklist-gated and atomic, even under two reviewers at the same time.
login.fact2Body: Paid answer keys are never sent to a student before the paper is unlocked.
login.fact3Body: Admin mutations write an audit entry with the actor and the before/after values.

payments.title: Payment requests
payments.subtitle: Oldest first. Approve only after the full checklist.
payments.checklistHint: All four boxes must be ticked before approving.
payments.dateRecentHint: The receipt date is close to the submission time.
payments.referenceMatchesHint: The reference on the receipt is {{reference}}.
payments.rejectReasonRequired: Write a reason the student can act on
payments.receiptMissing: The receipt file is no longer available.
payments.empty: No payment requests match this filter.
payments.notReviewable: This request is not waiting for review.
payments.confirmApproveBody: {{credits}} credits will be granted to {{student}}. This cannot be undone.

users.title: Students and staff
users.subtitle: Search by name, email or phone number.
users.name: Name
users.confirmBlockBody: They will be signed out and cannot use the app until unblocked.
users.confirmUnblockBody: They can sign in and use their credits again.

exams.title: Exam papers
exams.subtitle: Import, verify, publish and price papers.
exams.subject: Subject
exams.unlockCostHint: Leave empty to use the default price from Settings.
exams.confirmBlockBody: Students lose access immediately. Only the owner can lift a takedown, and it survives re-import.
exams.confirmPublishBody: Students will see it in the app straight away.
exams.confirmUnpublishBody: Students will no longer see it. Existing unlocks are kept.
exams.onlyOwner: Only the owner can change pricing or take a paper down.

import.title: Import papers
import.subtitle: Three CSV files from the plan (A1b). Nothing is written until you apply.
import.noErrors: No errors. You can apply this import.
import.dryRunOk: Dry run finished. Nothing was written.
import.hint: Files are read in your browser as UTF-8 and sent as text. Images and ZIP uploads are not supported yet.
import.samplesHint: Download the three CSVs to see the exact columns. The sample is a valid 10-mark paper.
import.copyPromptHint: Copies the full prompt. Paste it into any AI assistant, add the paper text at the end, then import the three files it returns.
import.copyFailed: The browser blocked the clipboard. Try again.
import.fileTooLarge: That file is larger than 2 MB. Split the paper and try again.
import.readFailed: The file could not be read. Try choosing it again.
import.stale: The files changed. Validate again before applying.

topics.title: Canonical topics
topics.subtitle: Topic keys used by question tags. Keys cannot be renamed after import.
topics.keyHint: Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore. Example: grammar
topics.empty: No topics yet. Add one before importing papers that use tags.

packages.title: Credit packages
packages.subtitle: Prices are locked into each purchase. Retire a package instead of deleting it.
packages.noDelete: Packages are never deleted: past purchases keep their snapshot.
packages.creditsRequired: Enter a positive whole number of credits
packages.priceRequired: Enter a positive whole price in SDG
packages.confirmRetireBody: Students will no longer see it. Past purchases keep their price.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Bankak, credit, payment and AI settings. Changes apply immediately.
settings.note: Changing the multiplier only affects future purchases; existing lots keep their price.

mail.title: Email delivery
mail.subtitle: Student password reset codes leave through this mailbox.
mail.toHint: A real message is sent to this address. Use an inbox you can open now.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every admin mutation, newest first.
audit.empty: No audit entries match these filters.

reports.title: Question reports
reports.subtitle: Students flag wrong keys, unclear wording and printing problems.
reports.question: Question
reports.notePlaceholder: What was checked and what changed

ai.title: AI controls
ai.subtitle: Usage, cost and the human review queue. No daily cap — the monthly budget is the only hard stop.

test.title: Connection self-test
test.subtitle: Owner only. Verifies the key, model and endpoint end to end.
test.hint: Sends one real, tiny request to the model and records it in the usage ledger. It costs a fraction of a cent.

review.title: AI review queue
review.subtitle: Low-confidence marks and generated questions wait here until a human decides.
review.notePlaceholder: What was checked and what changed
review.gradingHint: Approving applies these marks to the student's answer. Rejecting leaves it unmarked so the student can retry.
review.generationHint: Approving publishes these questions as a free practice paper. Rejecting refunds the student's credits.
